purpose: Use a fresh, permanently non-formal E21-E25 development cohort to run one bounded three-point stability-band screen around V11. All nine comparison methods and all three NSESche candidates are run symmetrically before any performance is read.

fresh_development_cohort.reason: V21 closed further E01-E03 threshold tuning. E21-E25 are generated before V22 results and are disjoint from unused E04-E10 and sealed confirmation E11-E20.

source.high_profile_note: The global frozen high profile remains 7k; V22 itself runs low only.

diagnostic_basis.reason_for_axis: V11 is the best low-load rollback point and the operational proxy has already been varied extensively. The remaining bounded, paper-compatible control is the absolute utility indifference band within which the outcome-blind operational proxy may break ties. The grid is fixed at -20%, center, and +20% around epsilon 15 before E21-E25 are captured or run.

development_matrix.result_blind_execution_order: Complete and QC all baseline and candidate runs before calculating any throughput, latency, cost, QPR, ranking, or candidate comparison.

eligibility_per_candidate: all five reference builds and candidate runs pass QC and result-blind pairing
all 45 baseline runs pass QC and result-blind pairing
mean fixed-window throughput ranks first against all nine baseline methods on E21-E25
mean QPR ranks first against all nine baseline methods on E21-E25
geometric-mean throughput and QPR ratios versus the V22b center candidate are each at least 0.98
geometric-mean latency and cost ratios versus the V22b center candidate are each at most 1.10
frozen V8 middle/high E01-E03 retain first-place throughput and QPR
selection_rule: Run all three candidates completely. Among candidates passing every gate, freeze the first in the fixed priority v22b, v22a, v22c (center first, then lower, then higher epsilon). If none pass, select none, do not subdivide the epsilon grid on E21-E25, and keep confirmation sealed.

confirmation.closure_requirement: For every load, optimized NSESche must rank first in mean fixed-window throughput and QPR against frozen E11-E20 baselines; otherwise report not closed without seed deletion or confirmation-set tuning.
